definition: Pietro Perona (born 3 September 1961) is an Italian-American educator and computer scientist.
details: He is the Allan E. Puckett Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computation and Neural Systems at the California Institute of Technology and director of the National Science Foundation Engineering Research Center in Neuromorphic Systems Engineering. He is known for his research in computer vision and is the director of the Caltech Computational Vision Group.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. And that idea, made concrete, is Pietro Perona.
